NORMAL.name: NORMAL
NORMAL.how_to_get: The basic, grassy, and plain biome.
NORMAL.description: The basic, grassy, and plain biome. This biome does not currently have any Auras related to it. It appears as a normal grassy map with no special features whatsoever. It is the default biome of the game, and the one that will be switched to after other weather/biomes disappear until another one is chosen. During Christmas events, this biome is replaced by Snowy; During Easter events, this biome is replaced by Eggland

WINDY.name: WINDY
WINDY.chat_message: A refreshing and cool wind passes through the world..
WINDY.how_to_get: Windy has a spawn rate of 1 in 500/s (0.2%/s) and a duration of 2 minutes.
WINDY.description: Windy has a spawn rate of 1 in 500/s (0.2%/s) and a duration of 2 minutes. There are no changes in the atmosphere and the ground, although the leaves on the trees move, and the swirl line of wind flow to the East. This biome has a Breakthrough Multiplier of 3x, it features 7 unique auras (and 1 mutation). It also spawns an item called "Wind Essence", which is used to craft the Strange Controller. The "Wind Essence" can also be used as an offer to the Grail of Resonance while the Windy weather is still present, giving off +2% Luck and +1% Roll Speed

SNOWY.name: SNOWY
SNOWY.chat_message: White snow and cold begin to cover the surroundings..
SNOWY.how_to_get: Snowy has a spawn rate of 1 in 600/s (0.166%/s) and a duration of 2 minutes.
SNOWY.description: Snowy has a spawn rate of 1 in 600/s (0.166%/s) and a duration of 2 minutes. During Christmas event 2025, this biome replaces the normal biome. This biome turns the ground white and envelops the map in a thin mist. This biome has a Breakthrough Multiplier of 3x, it includes 5 unique Auras. It also spawns an item called "Icicle", which is used to craft the Strange Controller. The "Icicle" can also be used as an offer to the Grail of Resonance while the Snowy weather is still present, giving off +2% Luck and +1% Roll Speed

RAINY.name: RAINY
RAINY.chat_message: Strong winds and showers sweep through the world..
RAINY.how_to_get: Rainy has a spawn rate of 1 in 750/s (0.133%/s) and a duration of 2 minutes.
RAINY.description: Rainy has a spawn rate of 1 in 750/s (0.133%/s) and a duration of 2 minutes. It starts to rain, and the atmosphere is covered in a gray, cloudy fog. This biome has a Breakthrough Multiplier of 4x, it includes 11 unique Auras (with 4 being mutations) and an exclusive. It also spawns an item called "Rainy Bottle", which is used to craft the Strange Controller. The "Rainy Bottle" can also be used as an offer to the Grail of Resonance while the Rainy weather is still present, giving off +2% Luck and +1% Roll Speed

SAND STORM.name: SAND STORM
SAND STORM.chat_message: A harsh Sand Storm blocks your path...
SAND STORM.how_to_get: Sandstorm is a biome released in the Era 9 update.
SAND STORM.description: Sandstorm is a biome released in the Era 9 update. It has a spawn chance of 1 in 3,000/s (0.033%/s) and lasts for 650 seconds (10 minutes and 50 seconds). The biome appears to be a desert-like map with sandy texture replacing the grass, the tree leaves are replaced to a yellow-ish color. The whole map is covered in sand, which represents a sandstorm in real life. This biome has a Breakthrough Multiplier of 4x, it includes 6 unique Auras (with 1 being a mutation). It also spawns an item called "Hour Glass", which can be used as an offer to the Grail of Resonance while the Sandstorm biome is still present, giving off +3% Luck and +1.5% Roll Speed

HELL.name: HELL
HELL.chat_message: A strong and violent energy of chaos overtakes the world..
HELL.how_to_get: The Hell Biome is a biome that released in the Era 7 update.
HELL.description: The Hell Biome is a biome that released in the Era 7 update. It has a spawn chance of 1 in 6,666/s (0.015%/s) and lasts for 666 seconds (11 minutes and 6 seconds). Not much currently is known about it, but from appearance it seems to be a biome that consists of trees having their leaves dyed red, waterfalls and lakes being turned into lava, and having a hell-themed atmosphere. This biome has a Breakthrough Multiplier of 6x, it includes 9 unique Auras (with 1 being a mutation) and an exclusive. It also spawns an item called "Eternal Flame", which is used to craft the Strange Controller. The "Eternal Flame" can also be used as an offer to the Grail of Resonance while the Hell biome is still present, giving off +5% Luck and +2.5% Roll Speed

STARFALL.name: STARFALL
STARFALL.chat_message: Beautiful and dreamy starlight pours into the world..
STARFALL.how_to_get: With a spawn rate of 1 in 7,500/s (0.013%/s) and a duration of 650 seconds (10 minutes and 50 seconds), the Starfall biome has a dark blue atmosphere with stars falling from the sky.
STARFALL.description: With a spawn rate of 1 in 7,500/s (0.013%/s) and a duration of 650 seconds (10 minutes and 50 seconds), the Starfall biome has a dark blue atmosphere with stars falling from the sky. The map seems darker, and the ground turns black and light blue. Stella's Star has a 1 in 20 (5%) chance of spawning inside the cave instead of regular potions and coins while this biome is active. This biome has a Breakthrough Multiplier of 5x, it includes 11 unique Auras (with 3 being mutations). It also spawns an item called "Piece of Star", which is used to craft the Strange Controller. The "Piece of Star" can also be used as an offer to the Grail of Resonance while the Starfall biome is still present, giving off +5% Luck and +2.5% Roll Speed

HEAVEN.name: HEAVEN
HEAVEN.chat_message: A hand of angel leads you into divine place...
HEAVEN.how_to_get: The Heaven is a biome that was released in the Eon 1-12 update.
HEAVEN.description: The Heaven is a biome that was released in the Eon 1-12 update. It has a 1 in 7,777/s (0.0128584%/s) chance of appearing, lasting for 240 seconds (4 minutes). During the Heaven biome, the map turns into a yellow-themed area as mist obscures the player's vision. The trees, grass, and other features also turn a yellow color. On the very top of the map, there is a yellow glowing sigil with a bright star in it. This biome has a Breakthrough Multiplier of 5x, it includes 12 unique Auras (with 2 being mutations). It also spawns an item called "Feather Vial", which is used to craft the Angel's Feather Lantern. The "Feather Vial" can be used as an offer to the Grail of Resonance while the Heaven biome is still present, giving off +5% Luck and +2.5% Roll Speed
HEAVEN.music_file: Pro Sound Effects - Heavenly Presence Eerie Melodic Tones Mystic.ogg

CORRUPTION.name: CORRUPTION
CORRUPTION.chat_message: Poisonous pollution spreads throughout the world..
CORRUPTION.how_to_get: The Corruption Biome is a biome that was released in the Era 7 Update.
CORRUPTION.description: The Corruption Biome is a biome that was released in the Era 7 Update. It has a spawn chance of 1 in 9,000/s (0.0111%/s) and lasts for 650 seconds (10 minutes and 50 seconds). Some purple particles appear on the map, and the water turns into a purple liquid. Additionally, the map is shrouded in a purple fog. On the top of the map, there is a purple orb. Similarly to the Heaven biome, black lines with purple outlines rain upon the island, it has a Breakthrough Multiplier of 5x, and it includes 6 unique auras (with 1 being a mutation) and an exclusive. It also spawns an item called "Curruptaine", which is used to craft the Strange Controller. The "Curruptaine" can also be used as an offer to the Grail of Resonance while the Corruption biome is still present, giving off +10% Luck and +5% Roll Speed

NULL.name: NULL
NULL.how_to_get: During the Null biome, the map turns into a gray-themed area as mist obscures the player's vision.
NULL.description: During the Null biome, the map turns into a gray-themed area as mist obscures the player's vision. The trees, ground, and other features also turn a gray color. This biome has a 1 in 10,100/s (0.0075%/s) chance of appearing every second, and only lasts for 99 seconds (1 minute and 39 seconds). According to the now deleted Official Trello, this biome's description reads as, "err#r. e##or. A f@ta1 err0r 0ccurred during biome se1ection......". This biome has a Breakthrough Multiplier of 1000x, and has 1 special, 4 unique auras and an exclusive. The Null biome is also necessary to get into The Limbo

DREAMSPACE.name: DREAMSPACE
DREAMSPACE.how_to_get: Not to be confused with Dreamscape, an aura with a similar name.
DREAMSPACE.description: Not to be confused with Dreamscape, an aura with a similar name. The Dreamspace biome is the second rarest biome, having a chance of 1 in 3,500,000/s (0.00002857%/s) to spawn during Normal Biome. This biome has a duration of 3mins 12sec (192s). This biome is themed pink, surrounded by pink effects similar as the effect while rolling a 1m+ aura. There are also tables, doors, beds, chairs that are colored pink floating in the sky. All the leaves of the trees turn pink and the wood turns white with white soil. In some corners of the island there are tall pink trunks that have many branches. The whole island is covered in pink mist. This biome is themed around someone who dreams and sees his imagination. There was a bug when released where you could accidentally obtain the new biome with the Biome Randomizer or the Strange Controller, but it was shortly fixed. Because of this bug, the first server to be in the Dreamspace biome and have players obtain both the ★ and ★★ Dreamspace auras; These players being Neon(NeonOof2) and Nexzo(NotNexz) each obtaining the first ★ and ★★ auras respectively. This biome has no Breakthrough Multiplier, and as of now has five auras, more could exist though. Each respective star auras have their unique features. ★ has one small pink star orbiting the player. ★★ instead has two medium sized pink stars orbiting the player , forming a 180° angle between each star. Lastly, ★★★ has the same two orbiting stars, as well as two pink doors to the side of the player. Meanwhile, Dreammetric, has its own distinct appearance. This biome can also spawn Heavenly Potion|Heavenly Potions, which can spawn on the ground with a chance of 3% every 10 seconds (1 guaranteed when biome spawns)

GLITCHED.name: GLITCHED
GLITCHED.duration: 2 minutes and 44 seconds (164 seconds) before disappearing
GLITCHED.how_to_get: The biome no longer sends the messages below in the chatbox when it spawns.
GLITCHED.description: The biome no longer sends the messages below in the chatbox when it spawns. The Glitched biome is the rarest biome in the game, having a chance of 1 in 30,000 (0.00333%) to be chosen every biome change. However, it had a 1 in 15,000 (0.00666%) chance during the "x2 Glitched Biome" event. Every tree has their leaves turn into a glowing glitchy computer fuzz while the entire map is covered in a deep darkness. The ground turns black and gray with the pitch-black sky, simulating the event where the "sky" parts breaks down. The biome lasts for 2 minutes and 44 seconds (164 seconds) before disappearing. All native auras (except auras native to Rare Biomes) ignore Breakthrough odds, meaning they are obtainable at their native rarities. It also grants the hidden achievement "??? (Something Went Wrong)" upon a player's first time encounter (Must be in the server before the biome spawns). This biome features four unique auras that cannot be obtained in any other biome. This Biome also doesn’t spawn a Biome-Exclusive Item. The Glitched biome also includes a special effect where every GUI would "Corrupt" for a brief period every once in a while, it also causes any sound playing to corrupt as well for the same duration

CYBERSPACE.name: CYBERSPACE
CYBERSPACE.how_to_get: The Cyberspace biome is the third rarest biome.
CYBERSPACE.description: The Cyberspace biome is the third rarest biome. It has a 1/5,000 (0.02%) chance to appear when using either the Strange Controller or the Biome Randomizer. The biome lasts for 12 minutes. This biome has a Breakthrough Multiplier of 2x, it includes 17 unique auras (6 being mutations) and two auras that cannot be obtained in any other biome

SINGULARITY.name: SINGULARITY
SINGULARITY.chat_message: The Singularity pulls in everything, including you...
SINGULARITY.duration: 20 minutes or until someone in the server rolls Astraios, which will play the aura's aftermath effect
SINGULARITY.how_to_get: It seems like you have committed an act you shouldn't have.
SINGULARITY.description: It seems like you have committed an act you shouldn't have. The Singularity biome has a 1/100 (1%) chance to replace the Starfall Biome when it spawns. The method of how Starfall spawns does not matter, be it from a Biome Randomizer, Biome Selector, or even just a naturally spawning Starfall. It can also be spawned using a Singularity Catalyst. If a player is present before the biome spawns and witnesses the cutscene of it spawning, the Accretion Disk buff will be given. The biome lasts for 20 minutes or until someone in the server rolls Astraios, which will play the aura's aftermath effect. This biome has a Breakthrough Multiplier of 5x, it includes 3 unique auras and 9 exclusives

TIME.name: TIME
TIME.spawn_chance: Passive — cycles between Daytime and Nighttime
TIME.how_to_get: Passive world state — it simply cycles between Daytime and Nighttime and never spawns as an event biome.
TIME.description: Time is a passive type of biome that doesn't interfere with any of the other biomes, except for a visual change. Time cycles between Daytime and Nighttime. Daytime has a Breakthrough Multiplier of 10x and includes 2 unique auras (one being a mutation). Nighttime has a Breakthrough Multiplier of 10x and includes 8 unique auras (with 3 being mutations)

GRAVEYARD.name: GRAVEYARD
GRAVEYARD.spawn_chance: Graveyard has a spawn rate of 1 in 4 (25%) per Nighttime, overriding the current biome except Glitched and Dreamspace, and lasts until Night ends.
GRAVEYARD.how_to_get: Graveyard has a spawn rate of 1 in 4 (25%) per Nighttime, overriding the current biome except Glitched and Dreamspace, and lasts until Night ends.
GRAVEYARD.description: Graveyard has a spawn rate of 1 in 4 (25%) per Nighttime, overriding the current biome except Glitched and Dreamspace, and lasts until Night ends. In the recent Halloween update, Graveyard was brought back, and now has a 1 in 3 (33.3%) chance to spawn during night, overriding any current biome except for Glitched and Dreamspace. This biome was added during the Halloween Update 2024, It consists of various shades of grey trees, grass, rocks, tombstones, and coffins are scattered across the map. These auras are only obtainable during the Halloween 2024 Event. These auras are only obtainable during the Halloween 2025 Event

PUMPKIN MOON.name: PUMPKIN MOON
PUMPKIN MOON.chat_message: An evil and eerie energy has taken over the world!
PUMPKIN MOON.spawn_chance: Pumpkin Moon has a spawn rate of 1 in 4 (25%) per Nighttime, overriding the current biome except Glitched and Dreamspace, and lasts until Night ends.
PUMPKIN MOON.how_to_get: Pumpkin Moon has a spawn rate of 1 in 4 (25%) per Nighttime, overriding the current biome except Glitched and Dreamspace, and lasts until Night ends.
PUMPKIN MOON.description: Pumpkin Moon has a spawn rate of 1 in 4 (25%) per Nighttime, overriding the current biome except Glitched and Dreamspace, and lasts until Night ends. In the recent halloween update, Pumpkin Moon was brought back with now 1 in 3 (33.3%) chance per Night, overriding any current biome except for Glitched and Dreamspace. This biome was added during the Halloween Update 2024, it consists of orange theming and adds lamp posts, pumpkins and dirt pathways to the map. During this biome, a merchant named "Jack" will spawn, selling a very large variety of potions, runes, and other objects for a currency known as "Pumpkin|Pump Tokens". In the 2025 Halloween Update, Jack was brought back but now contains a new feature known as Aura Hunts and a replaced currency known as Bounty Medals, along with selling auras. These auras are only obtainable during the Halloween 2024 Event. These auras are only obtainable during the Halloween 2025 Event

BLAZING SUN.name: BLAZING SUN
BLAZING SUN.chat_message: The hot sunlight begins to shine on you.
BLAZING SUN.how_to_get: Blazing Sun has a 1 in 4 (25%) chance of spawning whenever it turns Daytime (during Summer 2025, it could also be spawned after using Biome Randomizer or Strange Controller), lasting for 3 minutes.
BLAZING SUN.description: Blazing Sun has a 1 in 4 (25%) chance of spawning whenever it turns Daytime (during Summer 2025, it could also be spawned after using Biome Randomizer or Strange Controller), lasting for 3 minutes. Blazing Sun will override the current biome upon spawning. (Except for Rare Biomes) Blazing Sun had a Breakthrough Multiplier of 2x during Summer 2025 and was added during the Eon 1-6 Summer 2025 Update, it consists of orange effects like the corruption biome. It has some beams, and fire themed fog. These auras are only obtainable during the Summer 2025 Event These auras are only obtainable during the Summer 2026 Event Lo-fi Beats No Copyright Music it can be found on Youtube [ here]

BLOOD RAIN.name: BLOOD RAIN
BLOOD RAIN.chat_message: Drops of blood begin to fall from the sky...
BLOOD RAIN.spawn_chance: Blood Rain lasts for 10 minutes and is summoned by using a Cursed Rune Fragment during Graveyard or Pumpkin Moon which is obtainable from Fischl's shop.
BLOOD RAIN.how_to_get: Blood Rain lasts for 10 minutes and is summoned by using a Cursed Rune Fragment during Graveyard or Pumpkin Moon which is obtainable from Fischl's shop.
BLOOD RAIN.description: Blood Rain lasts for 10 minutes and is summoned by using a Cursed Rune Fragment during Graveyard or Pumpkin Moon which is obtainable from Fischl's shop. It consists of a bloody scenery and giant red crosses scattered around the map in different sizes with varying looks, with some being hollow as well. Deep maroon fog can be seen with surrounding water also being blood-like. Black coffins standing against some structures and buildings can also be found, with a similar glowing cross symbol as one of the map crosses

AURORA.name: AURORA
AURORA.chat_message: An aurora begins to appear in the sky...
AURORA.how_to_get: An aurora begins to appear in the sky...
AURORA.description: An aurora begins to appear in the sky... The aurora dissapears... Aurora lasts for 5 minutes and is summoned by using a Glowing Snow Globe during Snowy or naturally at a 1 in 50,000/s (0.002%/s) chance. The Glowing Snow Globe can be obtained by spinning the Christmas Roulette. The biome has a Breakthrough Multiplier of 2x and appears to be the exact same as the Snowy biome, with the only main difference being the Aurora manifesting in the sky

EGGLAND.name: EGGLAND
EGGLAND.spawn_chance: Eggland replaces the normal biome during the 2026 Easter Event.
EGGLAND.how_to_get: Eggland replaces the normal biome during the 2026 Easter Event.
EGGLAND.description: Eggland replaces the normal biome during the 2026 Easter Event. This biome turns the ground a light green and the trees' wood white, giant versions of the Point Eggs can be seen around the map; pink, green, blue and yellow colored leaves and flowers as well as large pink fog rain from above. It reduces the egg drop time from 1 minute to 30 seconds. Vibin Alone. It can be found on Youtube [ here]

INCINERATOR.name: INCINERATOR
INCINERATOR.chat_message: It's hotter than usual today! It's a heatwave!
INCINERATOR.how_to_get: The sun is rising even hotter today...
INCINERATOR.description: The sun is rising even hotter today... Incinerator lasts for 3 minutes 20 seconds (200 seconds) and can spawn at a 1/10 (10%) chance after firing the Event Turret (Overcharge/Normal doesn't matter). Incinerator appears similar to Blazing Sun but the effect on every player's screen is much more opaque and has heat particles added on to it. The map is also filled with flame effects spawning randomly. Whenever Incinerator spawns, a cutscene will play

THE HYPERSPACE REALM.name: THE HYPERSPACE REALM
THE HYPERSPACE REALM.how_to_get: Admin-only hub dimension that hosts the portals to the engineer realms.
THE HYPERSPACE REALM.description: The Hyperspace Realm is an exclusive biome that is linked to Prowler|Another Realm, the Engineer of Space. It can only be spawned by the developers. The Hyperspace Realm includes 1 unique aura The Hyperspace Realm|[ ABNORMALITY ] is a variation of The Hyperspace Realm that provides a different effect. The Hyperspace Realm|[ ABNORMALITY ] makes all native auras (except auras native to Rare Biomes) ignore Breakthrough odds, meaning they are obtainable at their native rarities. The Hyperspace Realm gives the Prowler|I effect. If you attempt to use the Biome Randomizer or Strange Controller, a warning message will pop up saying: "You're in a wrong dimension."
THE HYPERSPACE REALM.music_file: Camellia - Literal Crystal In The Cyphisonia.mp3

THE NULL'S EXISTENCE.name: THE NULL'S EXISTENCE
THE NULL'S EXISTENCE.how_to_get: The Null's Existence is an exclusive biome that is linked to Mastermind, the Engineer of Time.
THE NULL'S EXISTENCE.description: The Null's Existence is an exclusive biome that is linked to Mastermind, the Engineer of Time. It can only be spawned by the developers. The Null's Existence includes 1 unique aura. The Null's Existence gives the Mastermind|II effect. If you attempt to use the Biome Randomizer or Strange Controller, a warning message will pop up saying: "DID YOU REALLY THINK I WOULD LET YOU USE IT?"

THE CITADEL OF ORDERS.name: THE CITADEL OF ORDERS
THE CITADEL OF ORDERS.how_to_get: The Citadel Of Orders is an exclusive biome that is linked to Edict, the Engineer of Justice.
THE CITADEL OF ORDERS.description: The Citadel Of Orders is an exclusive biome that is linked to Edict, the Engineer of Justice. It can only be spawned by the developers. The Citadel Of Orders includes 3 unique auras. The Citadel Of Orders gives the Edict|III effect. The Citadel Of Orders used to be removeable by using a Biome Randomizer or Strange Controller because the Developers forgot to restrict it. This has now been fixed and the warning message is the default "[Item] Seems to not work right now..."

赤い満月.name: 赤い満月
赤い満月.how_to_get: 赤い満月|The Red Full Moon biome is an exclusive biome that is linked to Red Full Moon, the Engineer of Chaos.
赤い満月.description: 赤い満月|The Red Full Moon biome is an exclusive biome that is linked to Red Full Moon, the Engineer of Chaos. It can only be spawned by the developers. 赤い満月|The Red Full Moon includes 2 unique auras. Upon using the Biome Randomizer or Strange Controller during 赤い満月|The Red Full Moon biome, a warning message will pop up with obfuscated text. Red Full Moon's symbol shows up on the screen. During the Halloween 2025 Event, it was summoned in the beginning of second part of the event, and allowed players to roll every halloween aura at their native rarities. 赤い満月|The Red Full Moon biome gives the Red Full Moon|IV effect

LOST FOREST.description: The Lost Forest is a biome that was released in the Eon 1-30 update. It has a 1 in 8,128/s (0.012303149%/s) chance of appearing, lasting for 450 seconds (7 minutes and 30 seconds). During the Lost Forest biome, the map is shrouded in a deep green ambiance, enormous trees and stylistic windows are seen around the map, lights rise from the ground and small pixelated flowers are seen around. This biome has a Breakthrough Multiplier of 2x, it includes 17 unique Auras (with 5 being mutations)
LOST FOREST.how_to_get: The Lost Forest is a biome that was released in the Eon 1-30 update.
LOST FOREST.chat_message: Leaves and bark unearth around you..
LOST FOREST.name: LOST FOREST

THE RADIANT FOREST.description: "I will remember you again, I promise." The Radiant Forest is a Rare Biome that can only be spawned by using the Condensed Memory item inside of the Lost Forest biome during Nighttime, lasting for 900 Seconds (15 Minutes). During The Radiant Forest, a mechanic called "Moon Catch" becomes active, in which stars fall from the sky marked by a circle. Catching them gives a stack of Cor Lunae's Blessing, which grants +0.015x final luck up to 10 stacks. The biome has a breakthrough multiplier of 2x and will lock the current time to Nighttime while active; it includes 4 special, 4 unique auras (with 1 being a mutation) and 4 exclusives. During The Radiant Forest, a new mechanic called "The Seven Radiant Moons" becomes active. Located at the top of the screen, each moon lights up upon rolling a specific aura
THE RADIANT FOREST.how_to_get: "I will remember you again, I promise." The Radiant Forest is a Rare Biome that can only be spawned by using the Condensed Memory item inside of the Lost Forest biome during Nighttime, lasting for 900 Seconds (15 Minutes
THE RADIANT FOREST.chat_message: Yet again, THEIR Memories Begin to Let Go...
THE RADIANT FOREST.spawn_chance: The Radiant Forest is a Rare Biome that can only be spawned by using the Condensed Memory item inside of the Lost Forest biome during Nighttime, lasting for 900 Seconds (15 Minutes).
THE RADIANT FOREST.name: THE RADIANT FOREST
